descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-03 step 5; UAT 3.8; UAT 3.9; TFA-92592 AC 15-16 · “After step 5, the note is present or an explicit failure shows on return, never a blank screen or silence.”.

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S23 Real iPhone and Android: microphone dictation, Generate, lock or background for 30 s; then a wrong device clock

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U16 Each run records which AI ran: the note model (Haiku, or Mistral with the fallback recorded) and the speech-to-text engine used for the dictation (GPT-Live; Deepgram only with the ambient option). (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94422 AC 6)
  • U17 'Today' for the note (which vitals and labs count as today's, and the date written into the note) follows the server clock; a device with a wrong date or another time zone gives the same note. … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92592 AC 16) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U11 The note never presents a vital or lab from a previous day as today's; earlier values appear only with their date (e.g. 'Cr 1.1 on Oct 1'); if no vitals were dictated today, the note says so. … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.7; TFA-92592 AC 16) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local stack only: an Android emulator or dev build pointed at the local Convex on 4510/4511 (scripts/android-lane.ts adb reverse) and an iOS Simulator or dev build pointed at the local stack; @roundai.test account, one patient per mode. …

When Dictate the step-2 encounter with the microphone, Save & Extract, Generate, lock the phone (iOS) or background the app (Android) for 30 s, return. Then set the device date one day ahead and another time zone, reopen the chart and look at the note and its values

Then The dictation is transcribed and kept; on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows; the speech-to-text engine and the note model are recorded; with the wrong clock the note's 'today' values, dates and note date match a correctly set device

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester records the transcript, the note and the aiCallLog model and transcription rows against U4, U16 and U17. On main generation is in the client (known: TFA-92592 AC 15) and recordedDateLabel uses the device date. If a phone cannot reach the local stack, the step is recorded as Manual (needs-dev-or-prod) and is not run on dev. The web half of the wrong-clock check is S27

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S23

Real iPhone and Android: microphone dictation, Generate, lock or background for 30 s; then a wrong device clock

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status blocked in newspec-c/results.json → blocked (blocked).

Detail:

Not runnable here: it needs a real voice on a real phone and the live note model (forbidden on the local stack; on dev microphone dictation and phones are set aside). What the code says on 43c38a4f, recorded: the note is generated by the page (On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/).), so a phone that suspends or kills the web view before the model answers loses the note the way TC-14/S07 cells B/D and TC-25/S14 show; an Android emulator run on e02167f (dvc, OAT-03/S20) kept the note after 30 s in the background with a 25 s scripted model wait. The wrong-device-clock half is S27 (web) and known B18.

Evidence: 0 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Real iPhone and Android: microphone dictation, lock / background and the device clock.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
